title.en: Mental Health (Care and Treatment) (Designated Psychiatric Institution) Notification 2025

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Notification is the Mental Health (Care and Treatment) (Designated Psychiatric Institution) Notification 2025 and comes into operation on 1 April 2025.

2. The Minister designates the parts of Changi Medical Facility comprising the premises specified in the Schedule to be a psychiatric institution for the detention or treatment of mentally disordered persons under the Act.
3. Revoke the Mental Health (Care and Treatment) (Designated Psychiatric Institution) (No. 2) Notification 2010 (G.N. No. S 134/2010).
